Trapped in the suffocating confines of a decaying ancestral home, a young archivist discovers a sealed attic that has remained untouched for decades. As she sifts through dust-covered diaries and forgotten relics, she unwittingly awakens long-buried family secrets and a malignant presence determined to keep the past hidden. With every creak of the floorboards above, the walls seem to close in tighter, turning her historical research into a desperate fight for survival.
